name: CartBrim – Side Cart for WooCommerce
author: Plugin Nest

sections.description:
When a shopper taps Add to cart, most shops reload the page or send the shopper to the cart page. CartBrim keeps them where they are: a clean cart slides in from the side with the product they just added, everything else in the cart, the subtotal and a big Checkout button. They can change quantities or remove items right there, then check out or close it and keep shopping.

It works on phones and computers and needs no setup.

What shoppers see

  • A side cart with the product picture, name, chosen options, quantity buttons, a Remove link and the price of each item.
  • “Added to your cart”: a green line at the top names the product just added.
  • Subtotal and a true note: “Shipping is added at checkout.” (or taxes, or nothing) follows your own shipping and tax settings.
  • Checkout in one tap, and a View cart link for shoppers who want the full cart page.
  • A round cart button in the corner with the number of items, so the cart is one tap away on every page.
  • An empty cart shows a short message and a Continue shopping button.

When it opens

  • After Add to cart on product pages (without a page reload), on shop and category pages, and from WooCommerce blocks.
  • When the shopper taps your header cart icon or any link to the cart page.
  • Never on the cart and checkout pages: they already show the cart.

Works with your shop

  • Product pages send your real product form, so product options, add-on fields, quantity rules and stock limits work exactly as before.
  • Safe with page caching: the cart’s content is always the shopper’s own.
  • Your theme’s header cart and the Mini-Cart block stay in step.
  • Extras that show in WooCommerce’s mini cart show in the side cart too, for example a free shipping bar.
  • Classic themes and block themes, WooCommerce order tables (HPOS) and the cart and checkout blocks.
  • Translation ready, right-to-left ready, keyboard and screen reader friendly (focus stays in the cart, Escape closes it), and it respects “reduce motion”.

Settings

Find them under WooCommerce → CartBrim, with a live preview:

  • Turn the side cart on or off, and choose when it opens.
  • Add on product pages without reloading, on or off.
  • Open it from the header cart icon and cart links, on or off.
  • The corner cart button: on or off, bottom right or bottom left, and whether it shows when the cart is empty.
  • Show or hide the “added” line, the note and the View cart link; your own title and Checkout button text.
  • Slide in from the right or the left, and your button color (the text color is picked for you so it stays easy to read).

Pro

CartBrim Pro is a separate add-on with: product suggestions inside the cart (“You may also like”, one tap to add), a coupon box, more looks (a floating card, every color, width and corners) and a report of how the side cart helps your sales. The free plugin works fully on its own.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New, search for “CartBrim” and click Install, then Activate.
  2. Add any product to the cart in your shop: the side cart slides in.
  3. Optional: change it under WooCommerce → CartBrim.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does it replace my cart page or checkout?

No. The cart page and checkout stay exactly as they are. The side cart has a View cart link and a Checkout button that open them.

My shop goes to the cart page after Add to cart.

That is a WooCommerce setting: WooCommerce → Settings → Products → “Redirect to the cart page after successful addition”. CartBrim follows it. Turn it off to use the side cart.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes. The page holds an empty side cart; its content is loaded for each shopper.

Can I turn off the round cart button?

Yes, under WooCommerce → CartBrim → Side cart → Cart button in the corner.
